workshoptitle: Build Financial Intelligence with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Follow the Seer Bank journey from connected finance data to insight and controlled action.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1 (Optional): Finance Data Foundation
tutorials.description: Inspect the finance schema foundation and current object families.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Risk and Operations Dashboard
tutorials.description: Use traceable dashboard evidence to focus risk and operations review.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Transaction Documents with JSON Relational Duality
tutorials.description: Use JSON Relational Duality and SQL/JSON for transaction documents.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Risk Signal Intelligence with AI Vector Search
tutorials.description: Find related products and risk signals by meaning, not only keywords.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Financial Crime Network with Property Graph
tutorials.description: Reveal connected activity that can focus a financial-crime investigation.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Client Service and SLA Coverage with Oracle Spatial
tutorials.description: Add geographic evidence to service-routing and coverage decisions.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Predictive Risk, Capacity, and Revenue with Oracle Machine Learning (OML)
tutorials.description: Score and compare models where the supporting finance data can be reviewed.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Ask a Database Question with Select AI
tutorials.description: Ask a governed database question, then review the SQL and approved finance evidence behind the answer.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Let a Select AI Agent Carry Out a Controlled Review Action
tutorials.description: Use approved database tools to record a controlled review action, then inspect its action record and history.

tutorials.title: Conclusion
tutorials.description: Connect the nine hands-on labs to one practical finance outcome.

tutorials.title: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
